entities.summary: Aleksandr Pavlovich Lensky was a Russian actor, director and theatrical educator. He was born in Kishinev. He was an outstanding figure of theatre under the Russian Empire. He was the illegitimate son of Prince Pavel Gagarin and singer Olga Vervitsioti. He made his debut in 1865 in Vladimir at the theater under the direction of Alexandra Chitau-Ogarieva. Lensky died in Moscow and is buried in Kaniv.
